verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents exporting and importing realms as JSON files and separately exporting authorization configuration. Its Admin REST API, the kcadm.sh CLI and standards-based SCIM endpoints offer scripted, open-format access to users, groups, roles and clients. Data can live in a standard database such as PostgreSQL, and the use of standard OIDC/SAML protocols eases migration to another identity provider. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that realm exports cover users and credentials (including password-hash portability), end-user self-service export from the account console, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a full migration out.
